searchText: A concern has raised that clients should've had a chance to look and weigh what goes into the devnet. This is a valid concern so I'd hold off merging CFI'd EIPs into Heze for now, which will leave the PR that includes 8198 to Heze opened but not merged. (I can pull off 8365 and 8015, if people want to.) As we don't have a breakout or ACDC this week, we can socialize this at the next ACDT or FOCIL breakout to invite more people to this decision. In the meantime, we can discuss it async and please feel free to implement those CFI'd EIPs if you have resources to do so. I brought up this thread to discuss it as if we wait till acdt we gonna need to wait like another week before we can have clients branches out and in that pace, we won't be able to do a merged devnet by devcon so ideally we discuss what should go into a devnet in this thread what's the big deal having 8365 and 8015 in a devnet? we haven't even tested focil unhappy/censoring path we don't need them in the next devnet, but it should be fairly straightforward I thought. this can be done parallel also yes but just questioning the urgency of having this before devcon, this has 0 user impact unless you wanna demo that a 0x00 deposit is now burned I also don't understand the devcon reasoning. Is it because we will see each other irl that we can debug stuff easier? Or is it because we think people will start taking vacations after devcon? in person reasons mainly

excerpts.author: jih2nn
excerpts.content:
A concern has raised that clients should've had a chance to look and weigh what goes into the devnet. This is a valid concern so I'd hold off merging CFI'd EIPs into Heze for now, which will leave the PR that includes 8198 to Heze opened but not merged. (I can pull off 8365 and 8015, if people want to.)

As we don't have a breakout or ACDC this week, we can socialize this at the next ACDT or FOCIL breakout to invite more people to this decision. In the meantime, we can discuss it async and please feel free to implement those CFI'd EIPs if you have resources to do so.
